description: Is a date a business day in a country (and German state)? Returns weekend/public holiday, the next business day and holidays in the next days. Germany per state (computed); other countries via the Nager.Date open data API. Use it before promising delivery dates, scheduling calls or setting deadlines. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

days_ahead.description: Also list holidays within this many days (0–30, default 14).

region.description: Optional region; for Germany the state code, e.g. BY (Bavaria), NW, BE.

name: check_business_day
title: Check business day & public holidays
